name: Teleport Attack
body:
School transmutation (teleportation); Level sorcerer/wizard 7

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range touch
Target one creature or object touched, weighing no more than 50 lbs./level
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Fortitude negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You teleport a target creature or object into a solid surface or object that you can see within close range (25 feet + 5 feet/two levels). If the spell succeeds, the subject suffers 2d6 points of Constitution damage + 1 point of Constitution damage per round until freed and is helpless. It becomes half imbedded in the surface or object.
